t: A free computing curriculum for ages 5 to 16 with lesson plans and slides.
steps: Find the Teach Computing Curriculum on the National Centre for Computing Education site.
Browse the key stage pages and choose the stage closest to your grade.
Read the teacher guide for that key stage.
Create a free account if the site asks for one to download.
Check the unit for devices or software it needs.
Ask IT to install any software before the first lesson.
